title: cafeteria meetings
content: Hey, so I just wanted to point out I've had many visits and meetups with rather interesting people ranging from my own passed on family members to strangers to many famous people I've never met irl.... in this hotel/govt/school/hospital/jail style cafeteria style but I can never recall what was discussed upon waking up... Maybe sometimes it's a lounge. But it nothing like a cozy homey place. It's all very... waiting in the lobby kind of feeling. I don't know. Just wanted to share a weird repetitive mallworld type feeling I've had over the years with someone 💓
